name: B Testimonial – Build Trust with Rotating Customer Stories
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Show visitors what your happy customers say – add unlimited testimonial sliders and carousels anywhere on your site, no code required.

Why B Testimonial?

Nothing convinces a new visitor faster than the words of a satisfied customer. B Testimonial lets you collect all your testimonials in one place and display them as beautiful, rotating sliders on any page, post, or widget area.

Everything is fully customizable – colors, font size, navigation, and slider controls – and you can choose from five different design templates. The slider is responsive, and you decide how many columns appear on each device, so your social proof looks great on desktops, tablets, and phones alike.

Prefer the block editor? A fully customizable B Testimonial Gutenberg block is included, alongside a powerful shortcode generator for classic workflows.

Free Features

  • Five Design Templates: Pick the testimonial slider style that matches your site.
  • Unlimited Testimonials: Publish as many testimonials and carousels as you want.
  • Fully Responsive: Set how many columns show on each device.
  • Embed Anywhere: Display testimonials on pages, posts, and widgets.
  • Slider Controls: Fine-tune navigation and slider settings.
  • Color & Typography Options: Change text colors and font sizes to match your brand.
  • Powerful Shortcode Generator: Configure everything visually, then copy one shortcode.
  • Gutenberg Block: A fully customizable B Testimonial block for the block editor.
  • Broad Browser Support: Works on all major browsers including Safari, Firefox, and Chrome.

How to Use – Quick Start

With the shortcode generator:

  1. After activation, open the B Testimonial menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Add all the testimonials you want to show.
  3. Click Shortcode Generator.
  4. Customize the slider settings and colors, select a template, then copy the shortcode.
  5. Paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area and publish.

With the Gutenberg block:

  1. Open the post or page editor.
  2. Add the B Testimonial block (found under Common Blocks).
  3. Add your testimonial carousel and customize it as you want.
  4. Publish – done!

Use Cases

  • Service Businesses: Rotate client reviews on your homepage to build instant trust.
  • Online Stores: Show customer feedback near products and calls to action.
  • Agencies & Freelancers: Present client success stories in a polished carousel.
  • Local Businesses: Highlight happy-customer quotes on landing pages and sidebars.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “B Testimonial”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open the B Testimonial menu to add your first testimonials.

Manual installation:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  2. Choose the b-testimonial.zip file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  4. Use the shortcode generator or Gutenberg block to display testimonials.
sections.faq:
How do I install this plugin?

You can install it like any regular WordPress plugin – see the Installation tab for step-by-step instructions.

How many testimonials can I publish on my site?

You can publish unlimited testimonials – there is no limit.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

This plugin is compatible with most themes. If you ever find a conflict between our plugin and a third-party theme, please let us know and we will release an update to fix the problem.

Will this plugin work with other plugins I use?

This plugin is compatible with most plugins. If you find a conflict with a third-party plugin, please let us know and we will release an update to fix the problem.

How many slider design templates are included?

The testimonial slider ships with five different design templates you can choose from in the shortcode generator.

Does it work with the Gutenberg block editor?

Yes. The plugin includes a fully customizable B Testimonial Gutenberg block, so you can add and style testimonial carousels directly in the block editor.

Is the testimonial slider responsive?

Yes. The slider is fully responsive, and you can set how many columns are shown on each device size.

Can I change the colors and fonts of the testimonials?

Yes. You can customize text color, font size, navigation, and slider controls to match your site’s design.
